results.content: President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen 14 percentage points among Republicans since April of last year, while only a quarter of respondents approve of his handling of the Iran war, according to a new poll. Aug. 31Trump’s approval rating has decreased one point, to 32%, since March, and his disapproval rating has increased two points, to 64%, according to a University of Massachusetts Amherst poll of 1,000 respondents taken Aug. 21-26 (margin of error 3.5). Trump’s approval rating among Republicans has declined from 89% to 75% since April 2025, and his approval rating among 2024 Trump voters is down 10 points. Aug. 24Trump’s approval rating held at 33% in the latest Reuters/Ipsos
results.title: Trump Approval Rating Falls To 32% In Latest Poll - Forbes

results.content: # CNN’s senior data analyst: Trump’s approval rating ‘stuck on empty’ with no sign of recovery. President Donald Trump faced new polling data Friday showing his approval rating at a record low. During an appearance on CNN, the network’s senior data analyst Harry Enten revealed a new low for Trump’s net approval rating, according to his own aggregate. “This is a president who is stuck on empty, and it is just... “It’s just consistently low; It’s stuck on empty, stuck on neutral. “On May 28th, you go back a few months ago, minus-20 points. The president’s approval rating, simply put, is low, net approval rating is low, it is staying low and there is no sign that he’s getting out of the basemen
results.title: CNN’s senior data analyst: Trump’s approval rating ‘stuck on empty’ with no sign of recovery - NJ.com
